liebermann.notes: Annals from Hengist to 1377 by a Lichfield writer, using Huntingdon and (from the Leges Anglorum Londoniis collectae) f. 47 parts of the London-interpolated ECf retr; this piece on William's acceptance of Edward's laws is printed by Thorpe.

entries.text_de: British Museum Cotton Cleopatra D IX3, hinter Martinus Polonus, f. 35 Annalen von Hengist bis 1377; von einem Lichfielder, Ende 14. Jhs., der Huntingdon und (aus den Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Londoniis coll.4) f. 47 Theile des ECf retr Lond interpol., s. u. S. 627*, benutzt. Dieses ganze Stück über Wilhelm's Annahme der Gesetze Edward's im Zusammenhang druckt Thorpe Ancient laws p. v.
entries.text_en: British Museum Cotton Cleopatra D IX3: after Martinus Polonus, f. 35 annals from Hengist to 1377, by a man of Lichfield, end of the 14th century, who used Huntingdon and (from the Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Londoniis coll.4) f. 47 parts of the ECf retr Lond interpol., see below, p. 627*. This whole passage on William's adoption of Edward's laws is printed in context by Thorpe, Ancient laws p. v.

notes.text_de: Auch ein späterer Theil des Bandes ist Lichfieldisch; dann aber folgen Annalen (Hardy Descr. cat. III 352) aus Hereford, ausgezogen Mon. Germ. XVI 483.
notes.text_en: A later part of the volume is also from Lichfield; but then follow annals (Hardy, Descr. cat. III 352) from Hereford, excerpted in Mon. Germ. XVI 483.

transcription.doubts: Roman 'v' after 'Ancient laws p.' may be small capitals.
